messages:
sophie: quick design review request — new form patterns for settings page. sketch in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxxx. two topics: required-field signaling (asterisk vs explicit label) and delete flow for linked resources. can we quick-flag accessibility nits + copy? maria: re: asterisk — i don't love relying on visual affordances alone. screen readers don't announce an asterisk. prefer 'Email (required)' or 'Email • required' in the label. aria-required on the input too. dan: Inline validation question: should we validate on blur or only on submit? for this settings form some fields are optional, some required. blur validation can be noisy. kevin: my take: - required label text for accessibility + smaller asterisk as visual shorthand. - validate on blur for fields that are high-error (emails, urls) and on submit for others. - top summary for long form with multiple errors, inline for single-field edits. :thumbsup: liz: agree with kevin. also copy: avoid scary language for delete — 'Delete' is fine but reserve typed-confirm ("type DELETE") only for irreversible destructive actions like account delete. For removing a linked resource (e.g., linked repo) use modal with clear consequence text + an undo toast. maria: quick accessibility nit: visible 'required' in label should not duplicate to screen readers. use aria-label or aria-describedby carefully. example: and sophie: good — the sketch currently uses an asterisk only. i'll update to 'Label (required)' and include a smaller muted asterisk to keep visual density low. dan: about error announcements for SRs — if inline error appears we should use role="alert" or aria-live="assertive" so screen readers read the message when it shows. for top summary, focus should move to the summary container. kevin: +1. sample snippet for error link focus: ```html

Email is invalid

``` liz: microcopy suggestion for small deletes: modal header 'Remove linked repo?' body 'This will disconnect the repo from the project. You can re-connect later.' primary CTA 'Remove' (danger) second 'Cancel' and show an undo snackbar: 'Repo removed — Undo' for 5s. keeps flow less scary. maria: typed-confirm example should be reserved for "Delete customer account" or data-destruction ops. typed-confirm has cognitive cost and blocks automation (copy/paste). maybe use typed-confirm + server-side check for the most critical flows only. sophie: UX question: where do we show the required legend? top of form or inline on fields? kevin: if most fields are optional, put a legend at the top: 'Fields marked required are necessary to ...' For dense forms prefer inline label text to reduce back-and-forth. dan: also consider error density. For mobile, inline errors under field are better. For desktop wide forms, show inline + condensed summary at top with hashlinks. designbot: automated note — Figma file updated by sophie at 2025-03-22T14:05Z: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxxx (v2: required-labels + delete-modal copy). liz: quick accessibility QA checklist I run: - labels include programmatic required state (aria-required) - color is not the only required indicator (no color-only) - errors are keyboard focusable links in summary - no focus trap when undo snackbar shows - modals return focus to originating control on close maria: one more tiny nit: avoid using 'This action cannot be undone' as the only explanation. say what exactly will be lost and surface possible recovery steps if any. sophie: thanks all — i'll prototype two variants: (A) inline 'Label (required)' + small asterisk + blur validation on email/urls + top summary for multiple errors; (B) compact labels + submit-only validation but with clearer summary behavior. will post quick A/B screens later today. :sparkles: kevin: love it. if you want i can pair on the copy for the delete modal. sophie: yes pls — pinging @kevin when ready. dan: tiny follow-up: consider analytics events for error types + validation source (blur vs submit) so we can measure false-positive annoyance. sophie: added to the ticket. thanks folks! :party_parrot:
